## Body

From the prime silkworm, 2026-11-11 05:46 (stoat's refined finding): the 'MallocStackLogging' lines come from Copilot's own extension host (preloads/extension_bootstrap.mjs, which runs our native extension). Each extensions_reload starts a new host whose stderr writes to the tty and stacks footers, so the pane tap reads 'unrecognized' or 'composer-busy' and compacts park. Seen on spoonbill (after the 10 Nov reload rollouts), sole, orca and rising-kangaroo. Interim rule: compact Copilot seats BEFORE a reload rollout, not after. A seat that has reloaded several times since its last restart (stacked footers, MallocStackLogging text in the pane) is likely to drop a held compact. If it does, escalate rather than retry (the seat may need a restart). Fix candidates are in F180; Jordan decides whether to staff it.
